notes.title: Achievements and Gamepad Support
notes.content:
[b]What's new[/b]

[b]Gamepad Support (Works with Xbox 360 Controller and similar)[/b]


[b]21 New Achievements[/b]

[b]Learning to Fall[/b] - Complete the Tutorial
[b]First Jump[/b] - Complete Level 1
[b]Second Jump[/b] - Complete Level 2
[b]Third Jump[/b] - Complete Level 3
[b]Fourth Jump[/b] - Complete Level 4
[b]Fifth Jump[/b] - Complete Level 5
[b]Low Jump[/b] - Complete the game in Easy Mode
[b]Medium Jump[/b] - Complete the game in Medium Mode
[b]Great Jump[/b] - Complete the game in Hard Mode
[b]The Greatest Jumper[/b] - Complete the game in Extreme Mode
[b]Fast as a Falling Star[/b] - Complete one level with No Damage
[b]Gravity Force[/b] - Complete one level without Float
[b]Earth Tech[/b] - Use Blue Jetpacks 10 Times in One Play
[b]Lyricist[/b] - Collect you First Letter
[b]The Best[/b] - Get S Rank Every Level
[b]Try Again[/b] - Die 5 Times
[b]Persistence[/b] - Die 20 Times
[b]Are you ok?[/b] - Die 50 Times
[b]The Secret[/b] - The Dev’s Secret
[b]Detonator[/b]  - Destroy all the Level 1 Detonators
[b]Resources[/b] - Collect all Level 4 Itens
